raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #61172. The Anthropic entrypoint's system conversion silently drops any non-`text` content block (e.g. an `image` block) both in the top-level `system` field (`_convert_system_message`) and in inline system messages (`_extract_system_text`). The OpenAI endpoint already warns about this (#34072) but the Anthropic path never did, so unsupported blocks vanished without a trace.

## Claims

- Emit a `logger.warning_once` naming the dropped content type when an unsupported Anthropic system content block is ignored, mirroring the OpenAI endpoint's wording.
- `tool_addition` / `tool_removal` blocks in inline system messages do not warn: they are not ignored, `_resolve_tools` applies them to the tool list (review feedback).
- Keep the existing behavior of ignoring unsupported blocks (backward compatible) — only the warning is added.

## Validation

- `ruff check` / `ruff format` (0.14.0) and mypy clean.
- `tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py` + `test_protocol_exports.py`: 116 passed on the branch and on a merge with main `87e7dce3a7`.
- New regression tests: top-level and inline image blocks warn while text is preserved; text-only / string / billing-header cases do not warn; tool changes do not warn and are still applied; a mixed message warns only for the image block (inline and merged-system paths).
- The tool-change tests fail on the previous head and pass now. The warning tests use the existing `disable_log_dedup` fixture; without it, the inline-image test depended on test order.

## Details

Root cause: `_convert_system_message` / `_extract_system_text` drop any content block whose type is not `text` without notifying the caller, so callers can pass e.g. `system: [{"type":"image",...}]` and have it silently ignored. The fix keeps the drop (backward compatibility) but surfaces it with a once-per-type warning.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

nodes.body:
Thanks @vadiklyutiy, you're right. `tool_addition`/`tool_removal` blocks are only allowed in `role: "system"` messages, and `_resolve_tools` applies them to the tool list, so reporting them as ignored was wrong.

Fixed in 5d07ceb266: `_extract_system_text` now skips those two block types without a warning. Other non-text blocks still warn. The top-level `system` field needs no change, because its validator already rejects tool-change blocks.

Tests:

- A system message with text, `tool_addition` (by reference and by definition) and `tool_removal` produces no warning. The test also checks that `_resolve_tools` still applies the blocks: the deferred tool is loaded, the tool added by value is present, and the removed tool is gone. Both the inline and the merged-system paths are covered.
- Adding an `image` block to that message produces exactly one warning, and it names `image`.
- Both new tests fail on the previous head (4 warnings instead of 0 or 1) and pass now.

While checking this, I found that the previous head's own `test_inline_system_image_block_warns_and_ignored` failed when it ran after the top-level test. `warning_once` deduplicates per process, so the second identical warning never reached `caplog`. The class now uses the existing `disable_log_dedup` fixture. That change is test-only.

`test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py` + `test_protocol_exports.py`: 116 passed, both on the branch and on a merge with current main (`87e7dce3a7`). ruff 0.14.0 and mypy are clean.

Verified on CPU: 118 passed. With log dedup disabled, an image block in the top-level or inline system field warns exactly once on both the merged and non-merged paths, and text + tool-change system messages produce no warning. LGTM.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
The PR's inline loop warns for every non-text block, so valid `tool_addition`/`tool_removal` blocks log "it will be ignored" even though `_resolve_tools` applies them.

@@ -475,6 +475,142 @@ def test_system_string_unchanged(self):
         assert system_msg["content"] == "You are a helpful assistant."
 
 
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("disable_log_dedup")
+class TestUnsupportedSystemContentWarning:
+    """Unsupported (non-text) Anthropic system content blocks are dropped
+    for backward compatibility, but must not be dropped silently."""
+
+    _WARNING = "should only contain text content"
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tool_change_request(*extra_blocks: dict) -> AnthropicMessagesRequest:
+        return _make_request(
+            [
+                {"role": "user", "content": "Hello"},
+                {
+                    "role": "system",
+                    "content": [
+                        {"type": "text", "text": "Tools changed."},
+                        {
+                            "type": "tool_addition",
+                            "tool": {"type": "tool_reference", "name": "search"},
+                        },
+                        {
+                            "type": "tool_addition",
+                            "tool": {
+                                "type": "tool_definition",
+                                "definition": {"name": "db_query", "input_schema": {}},
+                            },
+                        },
+                        {
+                            "type": "tool_removal",
+                            "tool": {"type": "tool_reference", "name": "bash"},
+                        },
+                        *extra_blocks,
+                    ],
+                },
+            ],
+            tools=[
+                {"name": "bash", "input_schema": {}},
+                {"name": "search", "input_schema": {}, "defer_loading": True},
+            ],
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _assert_tool_changes_applied(result) -> None:
+        assert {t.function.name: t.function.defer_loading for t in result.tools} == {
+            "search": None,
+            "db_query": None,
+        }
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("merge_inline_system", [False, True])
+    def test_tool_change_blocks_do_not_warn(self, caplog, merge_inline_system):
+        """tool_addition/tool_removal are applied by _resolve_tools, not
+        ignored, so they must not trigger the unsupported-content warning."""
+        result = _convert(
+            self._tool_change_request(), merge_inline_system=merge_inline_system
+        )
+        self._assert_tool_changes_applied(result)
+        system_msgs = [m for m in result.messages if m["role"] == "system"]
+        assert [m["content"] for m in system_msgs] == ["Tools changed."]
+        assert not any(self._WARNING in r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("merge_inline_system", [False, True])
+    def test_only_ignored_block_warns_next_to_tool_changes(
+        self, caplog, merge_inline_system
+    ):
+        image = {
+            "type": "image",
+            "source": {"type": "base64", "media_type": "image/png", "data": "aGk="},
+        }
+        result = _convert(
+            self._tool_change_request(image), merge_inline_system=merge_inline_system
+        )
+        self._assert_tool_changes_applied(result)
+        warnings = [
+            r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if self._WARNING in r.getMessage()
+        ]
+        assert len(warnings) == 1
+        assert "'image'" in warnings[0]
+
+    def test_top_level_image_block_warns_and_ignored(self, caplog):
+        """An image block in the top-level system field is ignored with a
+        warning, while text blocks are preserved."""
+        request = _make_request(
+            [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
+            system=[
+                {"type": "text", "text": "You are a helpful assistant."},
+                {
+                    "type": "image",
+                    "source": {
+                        "type": "base64",
+                        "media_type": "image/jpeg",
+                        "data": "iVBORw0KGgo=",
+                    },
+                },
+            ],
+        )
+        result = _convert(request)
+        system_msg = result.messages[0]
+        assert system_msg["role"] == "system"
+        assert system_msg["content"] == "You are a helpful assistant."
+        assert any(
+            "should only contain text content" in r.message and "image" in r.message
+            for r in caplog.records
+        )
+
+    def test_inline_system_image_block_warns_and_ignored(self, caplog):
+        """An image block in an inline system message is ignored with a
+        warning instead of being silently dropped."""
+        request = _make_request(
+            [
+                {
+                    "role": "system",
+                    "content": [
+                        {"type": "text", "text": "Be concise."},
+                        {
+                            "type": "image",
+                            "source": {
+                                "type": "base64",
+                                "media_type": "image/png",
+                                "data": "aGVsbG8=",
+                            },
+                        },
+                    ],
+                },
+                {"role": "user", "content": "Hello"},
+            ],
+        )
+        result = _convert(request)
+        system_msgs = [m for m in result.messages if m["role"] == "system"]
+        assert system_msgs
+        assert all(m["content"] == "Be concise." for m in system_msgs)
+        assert any(
+            "should only contain text content" in r.message and "image" in r.message
+            for r in caplog.records
+        )
+
+

+                            "be ignored.",
+                            block.type,

+                        continue
+                    if block.text:
                         # Strip Claude Code's attribution header which contains

                         if block.text.startswith("x-anthropic-billing-header"):
@@ -396,7 +404,18 @@ def _extract_system_text(cls, msg) -> str | None:
             return text
         parts: list[str] = []
         for block in msg.content:
-            if block.type == "text" and block.text:
+            if block.type in ("tool_addition", "tool_removal"):
+                # Not text, but not ignored: _resolve_tools applies them.
+                continue
+            if block.type != "text":
+                logger.warning_once(
+                    "Anthropic system messages should only contain "
+                    "text content. Found content type: '%s'; it will "
+                    "be ignored.",
+                    block.type,
+                )
+                continue
+            if block.text:
                 if block.text.startswith("x-anthropic-billing-header"):
                     continue
                 parts.append(block.text)
